child.text:
[{"insert":"Hip Thrust March + Single Leg Hand Support DB RDL

Two glute and hamstring movements that work the posterior chain from different positions. The hip thrust march holds the top of a hip thrust while alternating knee lifts, which demands the glute to stabilize the pelvis through each single leg moment. The single leg hand support RDL that follows loads the hamstring and glute through a hinging pattern on one leg at a time. The hand support is there for balance, not to take the load off the working leg. Push close to RPE 8-9 on both movements in each set.
"}]
